findings.description: The requirement says to change all three pins to low on detection of fault code 1 to 7 or 9. SYS-SUP-053 already drives those pins low during start-up, when codes 5, 6 and 9 can be detected. A pin already low cannot undergo the specified change to low.
findings.requested_change: State the required low pin condition so it also covers pins already low when a fault is detected, while retaining the 49 ms bound from CON-SUP-133.
